'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Patrick Johnson LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Patrick Johnson]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Username:''' PMJ
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
